body:
## Pull request overview

Refactors the `skills/` documentation modules into a shadcn-ui–style layered structure (concise `SKILL.md` + detailed `rules/` + `evals/`) while keeping each skill independently usable, and deprecates `objectstack-hooks` by moving its content into `objectstack-data`.

**Changes:**
- Added layered `rules/` + `evals/` scaffolding across multiple skills, with new rule documents.
- Refactored `objectstack-data` and `objectstack-kernel` skills into shorter `SKILL.md` files that link to detailed rules.
- Deprecated `skills/objectstack-hooks` and redirected readers to `objectstack-data/rules/hooks.md`; updated `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 27 out of 27 changed files in this pull request and generated 15 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| skills/objectstack-ui/rules/view-types.md | New UI view-type guidance and examples |

| skills/objectstack-quickstart/evals/README.md | Placeholder evals structure doc |
| skills/objectstack-kernel/rules/service-registry.md | New kernel DI/service registry guidance |
| skills/objectstack-kernel/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md | New plugin lifecycle guidance |

| skills/objectstack-automation/evals/README.md | Placeholder evals structure doc |
| skills/objectstack-api/rules/rest-patterns.md | New REST patterns doc |
| skills/objectstack-api/evals/README.md | Placeholder evals structure doc |

</details>

The examples here don’t match the actual UI `ListView` schema: list views use `filter` (an array of filter rules) rather than `filters: { ... }`, and the sort key is `orderBy` in the schema/tests (not `sort`). Using the wrong shape will mislead users and make copy/paste examples invalid; please update the snippet to match `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` + `view.test.ts` conventions.

The documented REST routes here appear outdated. The REST server in `packages/rest` exposes data routes under `/api/v1/data/:object` and `/api/v1/data/:object/:id` (see `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts`), not `/api/v1/objects/...`. Please update the endpoint list to the current routing to avoid sending users to non-existent paths.

The driver selection table lists `SQLiteDriver` and `PostgreSQLDriver`, but the repo’s driver packages expose `SqlDriver` (configured via Knex `client`) plus `TursoDriver` and `InMemoryDriver`. Please update the table to reference the actual exported driver classes/packages to prevent confusion and broken imports.

Several examples use `console.log(...)` inside hook handlers. Elsewhere in this skill (and in core code) the recommended pattern is `ctx.logger.*` so logs are structured and respect log-level configuration. Please replace these `console.log` usages with `ctx.logger` in the examples to keep guidance consistent and production-safe.

This rules doc starts with a full skill-style YAML frontmatter block (`---`, `name`, `compatibility`, etc.). Other `rules/*.md` files don’t include frontmatter, and the `name` here is still `objectstack-hooks`, which is confusing now that this content is nested under `objectstack-data`. Please remove this frontmatter (or convert it into a normal heading) and ensure the metadata isn’t misattributed.

The “14 lifecycle events” list includes `beforeFindOne/afterFindOne`, `beforeCount/afterCount`, and `beforeAggregate/afterAggregate`, but the current ObjectQL engine only triggers hooks for `find`, `insert`, `update`, and `delete` (e.g. `beforeFind`, `beforeInsert`, etc.). `findOne` currently does not trigger hooks at all, and there are no count/aggregate hook trigger points implemented. Please either update the list to the events that are actually fired today, or clearly label the additional events as schema-level/planned-but-not-yet-executed.

This sentence says “all 14 built-in hooks”, but the kernel bootstrap/shutdown currently only triggers `kernel:ready` and `kernel:shutdown`. The broader list of data hooks described in `rules/hooks-events.md` isn’t actually wired as kernel triggers. Please reword this line to avoid overstating what’s built-in today (or update the underlying rules doc accordingly).

This section says `PluginContext` provides “three core methods”, but the list includes four service-registry methods (`registerService`, `getService`, `replaceService`, `getServices`). Please fix the wording (or the list) so the doc matches the API shape in `packages/core/src/types.ts`.

This rule file includes several recommendations/examples that conflict with each other: the “Correct — Getting Service in start()” example registers `null` in `init()` as a placeholder, but the Best Practices section later says “Don’t register null — register a real instance or factory”. Please pick one supported pattern (ideally a factory via `kernel.registerServiceFactory`) and make the examples + best practices consistent.

This file documents `data:*` and `metadata:changed` as “built-in hooks” on the kernel hook system, but there’s no evidence in `packages/core` that these are actually triggered (only `kernel:ready`/`kernel:shutdown` are triggered during bootstrap/shutdown). As written, this will lead plugin authors to register hooks that never fire; please either (1) scope this doc to the kernel hook bus only, or (2) clearly distinguish ObjectQL data hooks (`beforeInsert`, `afterUpdate`, etc.) from kernel hooks and document the correct registration mechanism.

The HookContext section implies `ctx.api` is available for cross-object CRUD inside hooks, but the current engine doesn’t populate `api` on the hook context it constructs (it only sets `object`, `event`, `input`, `session`, `transaction`, `ql`). Please adjust the docs to reflect that `ctx.api` may be undefined unless/until it’s wired, and include the recommended alternative (using `ctx.ql`) where appropriate.

The Kanban config example doesn’t align with the spec: the schema uses `kanban.groupByField` and `kanban.columns` (plus top-level `columns`), not `groupBy` / `cardFields`. Please update this snippet to the actual keys so it validates against `ListViewSchema`.

The “Duplicate Registration” example/comment is inaccurate: `registerService()` throws when the name is already registered (see `packages/core/src/plugin-loader.ts`), it does not “overwrite silently”. Please update this incorrect/correct pair to reflect the real behavior and error mode.

The `init()` example registers `ctx.hook('data:beforeInsert', ...)`, but the data lifecycle hooks shown here are not currently triggered by the kernel hook bus. Data lifecycle interception is implemented in ObjectQL via its hook system (`beforeInsert`, `afterFind`, etc.) rather than `ctx.hook('data:*')`. Please update this example to use the actual ObjectQL hook registration approach (or explicitly mark `data:*` as planned/not yet wired) so plugin authors don’t follow a non-functional pattern.

The “Correct — Driver Configured” snippet uses `InMemoryDriver` but doesn’t import it. Since this file is intended as copy/pasteable guidance, please add the missing import (from `@objectstack/driver-memory`) or adjust the example to match the imports shown.
